name.fr-FR: Discours de l’état et des grandeurs de Jésus
name.en-US: Discourses on the State and Grandeurs of Jesus
name.pt-BR: Discursos sobre o estado e as grandezas de Jesus

description.fr-FR: Le chef-d’œuvre de Bérulle (1623) : douze discours sur le mystère de l’Incarnation, l’unité de Dieu et les trois naissances de Jésus, précédés de la dédicace, des approbations et de la préface.
description.en-US: Bérulle’s masterpiece (1623): twelve discourses on the mystery of the Incarnation, the unity of God and the three births of Jesus, preceded by the dedication, the approbations and the preface.
description.pt-BR: A obra-prima de Bérulle (1623): doze discursos sobre o mistério da Encarnação, a unidade de Deus e os três nascimentos de Jesus, precedidos da dedicatória, das aprovações e do prefácio.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du cardinal de Bérulle, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856 (reprint of Bourgoing’s 1644 collected edition); archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors, merged columns and some chapter openings the scan lost remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Bérulle died in 1629; the 1856 edition is public domain.
